recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If CQI wants stronger core supplementalData linkId/code/description structure in MeasureReport, raise and resolve a separate structural issue because adding it under FHIR-49670 would conflict with the FHIR-33192 reversal.
issue_request: FHIR-49670 asked to clarify MeasureReport linkage to the Measure being reported for group, population, stratifier, and supplementalData, including preservation of codings and descriptions where corresponding MeasureReport elements exist. Jira status is Applied with Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6.
initial_application: Commit 70bdb0961beee8ce56803a076c9d26d9677ff391, merged through HL7/fhir#3423, updated MeasureReport definitions for group, population, stratifier, linkId, code, and description guidance. No existing Issue-Reconcile-Key audit for FHIR-49670 was present on the combined branch before this reconciliation.
additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active resources in fhir.ini. Related final decisions matter for supplementalData: FHIR-33192 reversed a proposed supplementalDataElement/code/description backbone and FHIR-37559 established MeasureReport.supplementalData as Reference(Resource). Current quality-reporting guidance documents supplementalData reporting through referenced resources and contained Observations; later FHIR-50488 reuses the same reporting model for additional $evaluate supplementalData inputs.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current MeasureReport StructureDefinition already contains SHALL correspondence and coding/description guidance for group, population, and stratifier, while supplementalData is correctly handled by the existing Reference(Resource) element and quality-reporting narrative rather than by non-existent child elements.
